New words

Model → chat → assistant → agent

Each stage = the previous one + one new ability.
GenAI Basics • Lesson 07 • The Microsoft Copilot ecosystem03 / 24
New words

Assistant or agent: who drives the work

An assistant answers one request. An agent gets a goal, takes many steps itself, and you approve.
GenAI Basics • Lesson 07 • The Microsoft Copilot ecosystem04 / 24
How it works

Inside are the same models you called in L03

Copilot is a wrapper: a model + what it can see + what it is allowed to do.
LEVEL 1
Answers
chat: question → text. You copy it yourself.
LEVEL 2
Edits the document
Word, Excel, PowerPoint: changes the file, you see what changed.
LEVEL 3
Does the work (agent)
plans the steps itself: searches, drafts emails, builds files. Asks for approval.
  • Models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude and Microsoft's own MAI models. Auto picks the model for you.
  • Model names change every month: remember the levels, not the names.
GenAI Basics • Lesson 07 • The Microsoft Copilot ecosystem05 / 24
The app

One Microsoft Copilot app, two doors

Since September 2026 the personal and work Copilot are one app. Data never flows between the accounts.
Personal: chat, voice, images; sees the web and what you give it
Work: Copilot Chat free; with a licence: your mail, files, meetings
Name dictionary
Office app→Microsoft 365 Copilot app→Microsoft Copilot
Bing Chat→Copilot
Copilot Pro→retired → Microsoft 365 Premium

Demo B • wow

Copilot Vision: the assistant sees the window you share

Open release_checklist.txt in Notepad.
Copilot → voice → Vision → pick the Notepad window.

On your PC • Windows and Edge

Copilot in Windows: what it can do and where the limits are

What you can do for free (personal account)
  • Chat and voice: on any Windows 11 PC; “Hey Copilot” is a setting.
  • Screenshot and Vision: share a window; Copilot highlights but does not click.
  • Files: upload or find on the PC and ask about them.
  • Create an image or a Word, Excel, PowerPoint file from an answer.
  • Connect OneDrive, Outlook.com, Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar: on copilot.com and mobile.
Limits (official, as of 13 Oct 2026)
20files per chat
50 MBper file: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PNG, JPEG, TXT, CSV, MD
18 mochat history kept (default)
?message, length, image and voice limits are not published; a Microsoft 365 subscription gives more
Copilot+Copilot+ PC only: Click to Do, Recall, the Settings agent
Personal account: training on your chats is on by default. Turn it off: profile → Settings → Privacy → Training on conversation activity.
Edge: questions about open tabs and history, Journeys. The separate Copilot Mode closed in May 2026; browser actions: Premium, US only.

For work • Word

Word: a draft from a file and edits right in the document

  • Draft: “write a brief from /meeting_notes”: Copilot uses your file as the source.
  • Edit: select a paragraph → “shorter”, “simpler”, “as a table”.
  • Check: Copilot highlights the changed words and cites the source.
work licence
TEAMAnna's brief from slide 8 is the same prompt in Word, with a file instead of pasted text.

For work • Excel

Excel: ask the table in words, then check the numbers

  • Formulas, pivots, charts, formatting: in words.
  • The =COPILOT() function from old videos was removed on 14 Sep 2026.
work licence
The Prime rule applies only in the city. Outside the zone one order is free: #1011 ($130, the “from $100 for all” rule). Copilot did not know the rule because we did not give it, and marked its assumption with an asterisk.

Your own agent • Agent Builder

An agent is Copilot with your instructions and your knowledge

Agent Builder exists even in the free Copilot Chat of the IT Park school account: Agents → New agent.
Instructions
who you are, how you answer, what you never do
Knowledge
free: the web and up to 4 sites; files and SharePoint if the organisation enabled billing
Skills
code and Word/Excel/PowerPoint files, images: on by default
Starter prompts
suggestion buttons for the user
Ideas for students and teams
  • Support helper: answers from the delivery rules (our example)
  • Course tutor: explains lesson topics and quizzes you
  • Rubric checker: compares homework with the 6 checks
  • Translator: the Text Translator template: RU ↔ EN ↔ UZ
  • Post writer: drafts announcements in the brand style
  • Department FAQ: answers from the study-rules files
freepreview, not for all

Your own agent • how to build

We built a support agent in 5 minutes: a real run

Our prompt: “Create a ‘Courier support helper’ agent… Prime is free from $75 only in the city; from $100 free for all; city $7.50, outside $18.00. Show the calculation, ask if data is missing, never invent discounts.” Asked “how much is delivery for $70?”, the agent asked back for the zone and Prime.

For developers

GitHub Copilot: Copilot for code (more in L16)

Four safety rules
Copilot sees only what you can open.
Work data is protected by contract; in a personal account turn training off.
No passwords, keys or customer data in chat.
An answer is a draft: check numbers and names.

Practice

Homework: the courier team's week with Copilot

Only free Copilot is needed: personal or IT Park school. Hand in one document with screenshots.
Brief from meeting_notes.md + “what Copilot added” + one invention or mistake you found.
Table: paste orders.csv as text, ask the slide 13 question with the rule, and check by hand.
Creative: text for 3 slides or a launch picture.
Your map: 5 tasks from study or work → which Copilot, what it sees, whether it is free.
Grading: 6 checks
  • source named
  • inventions marked
  • numbers checked by hand
  • real screenshots
  • the map names the product and what it sees
  • no names, e-mails, secrets
